performance_history.note: No prior real newsletter issue to grade. The only published post was a placeholder titled 'New post' sent to a single test recipient. Baseline at run time: 14 active subscribers, +2 net new in 7 days, 0.0% open/click (no real campaign yet), earnings $2.24 (7d).

Issue #7 (2026-08-17) is the newest published post and was graded this run. On a 13-recipient send it drew a 30.77% open rate (4 opens) and at least one verified click-through, so engagement per issue is healthy, but a single unsubscribe reads as a 7.69% churn rate and the active list has drifted from 14 (issue #1) to 12 with no net growth in the trailing week. On a base this small every action swings the percentages hard, so numbers are directional, not statistically meaningful. Priority: subscriber growth.
